# Session Recovery Checklist: Android Media Shell

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for background execution, the always-resident service, session lifecycle (Pause versus Stop versus completion), content-fingerprinted positions, the rate ladder, and engine-failure recovery
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/storage-schema.md](../contracts/storage-schema.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are background-service requirements complete: media-playback type, manifest declaration, required permissions, and an automated manifest check that fails on regression? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for the Android 14+ cold-start refusal condition, including which exception or platform signal triggers the stated-reason path? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for every session-end kind (Pause, Stop, completion, kill, power loss, battery death, network loss) with its storage consequence and next-launch surface? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032, Spec §FR-032a, Spec §FR-032b]
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for the consent source that bounds automatic engine fallback (where consent lives, which engines are eligible)? [Gap, Spec §FR-023c, Spec §SC-052]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for repeated engine failure (re-offer over remaining engines, each attempt recorded) and for the no-alternative terminal state (paused with stated reason)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023a, Spec §SC-040]
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for degradation when an engine supplies no sentence or node boundaries for rewind-snap and re-anchor? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-038]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the always-resident component unambiguously defined as the playback service itself (exactly one resident, one notification), not a second lightweight component? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009a]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the residency-versus-teardown boundary explicit: resident while something is resumable, torn down at document end? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009a, Spec §FR-032f]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the "5% of paused duration, capped at 30 s, then sentence start, total movement never beyond 30 s" rule stated without residual contradiction between proportional, snap, and cap terms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the fallback order explicit in both directions: remaining same-tier first, then higher tiers in registry order, Edge last and never default — including whether descent to a lower tier is permitted? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023c]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the rate ladder closed and fully specified: seven rungs, one step per press, saturation (not wrap or failure) at both ends? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Spec §SC-026]
- [x] CHK012 - Is app-wide rate memory explicit: new sessions open at the last used rate (1.0x on first use), surviving app close, never per-document? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019b, Spec §SC-036]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Are the two 3-second bounded offers (deliberate-pause resume auto-start versus engine-failure automatic fallback) consistent in shape yet distinguished in trigger, default, and expiry consequence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032c, Spec §FR-023a]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the auto-start permission (FR-032c deliberate-pause reopen) consistent with the no-unsolicited-audio prohibition (FR-031) and its unexpected-end exclusion (FR-032d)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, Spec §FR-032c, Spec §FR-032d]
- [x] CHK015 - Are Stop-equals-completion storage semantics consistent: both clear the stored position and offer no resume? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032, Spec §FR-032b, Spec §FR-032e]
- [x] CHK016 - Are edited-document rules consistent: edited-while-idle treated as a different document with no resume, versus edited-during-playback recovering to paused? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036a, Spec §FR-032d]
- [x] CHK017 - Is position representation consistent: time-offset independent of structure for skips, yet re-anchored to sentence or node boundaries across voices and engines? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-038, Spec §Key Entities]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 - Can "resumed at last spoken position replaying at most 30 s after kill" be objectively verified in 10/10 trials? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK019 - Can "deliberate reopen auto-continues within 4 s of the offer with or without action" be objectively verified distinctly from "unexpected end produces no audio until explicit resume"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-020, Spec §SC-021]
- [x] CHK020 - Can "moved or renamed recognised as same; edited content recognised as different with no approximate match" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-022, Spec §SC-038]
- [x] CHK021 - Can "residency tracks resumability (one resident while resumable; zero after completion)" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-049, Spec §SC-043]
- [x] CHK022 - Can mechanism-level failover against two stand-in engines be objectively distinguished from hardware-level evidence against two real engines, with ownership of the carried-forward obligation? [Traceability, Spec §SC-051, Spec §SC-044, Spec §FR-023b]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for the resume offer while locked or backgrounded (countdown behaviour when the app leaves the foreground)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-032c]
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for document end racing a still-open 3-second offer (completion versus pending choice mutual exclusion)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-023a, Spec §FR-032f]
- [x] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for a skip landing past a document boundary (clamp, end-of-document paused state, no wrap or silence)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, Spec §SC-016]
- [x] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for power loss mid-sentence (position survives, replay bounded at 30 s without relying on a final write)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-032a]
- [x] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for network loss while paused (stored position preserved, not cleared)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032a, Spec §FR-026]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 - Are dependencies on the document and synthesis features stated as interface consumption (parsing, segmentation, synthesis, voice selection outside this feature) with the handoff representation fixed? [Dependency, Spec §FR-024, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 - Is Android Auto exclusion explicitly recorded as deliberate deferral rather than oversight? [Assumption, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK030 - Is the two-engine minimum recorded with its split verification (stand-ins now, real offline-plus-cloud later) and its consent-bounded registry order? [Assumption, Traceability, Spec §FR-023b, Spec §Assumptions]
